author: Inside Edition
description: Stars of new and returning shows hit the red carpet for the annual CBS Fest. LL Cool J will star in a "NCIS" spinoff to be called "NCIS New York" so-starring Scott Caan. Donnie Walberg will return in the "Blue Bloods" spin-off "Boston Blue." Carrie Preston will be returning for season four of "Elsbeth." Creators of the hit show "Ghosts" comes "Eternally Yours" with a comedic take on vampires. The night ended with a performance with Reggae legend Ziggy Marley.
title: CBS Celebrates Fall Lineup

author: Inside Edition
description: A baby monkey in Guadalajara, Mexico, is relying on a plush toy for companionship after getting rejected by his mother. Yuji, who is about 44 days old, is being cared for by staff at the Guadalajara Zoo. Veterinarians stepped in to help after his mother failed to properly care for him.  The patas monkey is tiny, weighing about 2 pounds, and is being fed several times a day to help his development and survival. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Plush Toy Giving Baby Monkey Companionship After Mother Abandons Him
